requirement: A user shall be able to submit a URL string for analysis.
measurement_method: Browser DOM submit event triggers POST /scan

requirement: The system shall reject empty submissions and prompt the user to enter a valid URL.
measurement_method: Pydantic schema validation rejects empty string

requirement: The system shall display a specific rate-limit error message when the VirusTotal API returns an HTTP 429 status code.
measurement_method: Mock HTTP 429 response raises UpstreamRateLimitError

requirement: The system shall abort the VirusTotal API call and display a failure message if a response is not received within 10 seconds.
measurement_method: Async timeout triggers UpstreamServiceError within 5.0s budget

requirement: The system shall return a "cannot be analyzed" message when the submitted URL resolves to a local intranet address.
measurement_method: IP validator rejects RFC 1918 private subnets

requirement: The system shall classify a URL as "ambiguous" if the VirusTotal threshold does not conclusively meet the defined safe or unsafe criteria.
measurement_method: Score evaluation logic returns Ambiguous verdict

requirement: The system shall display a visual loading indicator while the VirusTotal API request is in flight.
measurement_method: DOM check verifying aria-busy or spinner visible during request

requirement: A user shall be able to submit a new URL directly from the results dashboard without navigating back to the initial submission page.
measurement_method: DOM check for active input form on results page

requirement: The system shall display the word "Safe" alongside a green visual element when the API risk score falls below the danger threshold.
measurement_method: DOM inspection of text content and CSS class on clean report

requirement: The system shall display the word "Unsafe" alongside a red visual element when the API risk score meets the danger threshold.
measurement_method: DOM inspection of text content and CSS class on malicious report

requirement: The system shall reject a submitted URL exceeding 2,048 characters.
measurement_method: Boundary test asserting ValidationError on string length 2049

requirement: The system shall strip leading and trailing whitespace characters from the URL string prior to validation.
measurement_method: Unit assertion that whitespace-padded input normalizes cleanly

requirement: The system shall follow HTTP redirects to resolve shortened URLs to their final destination before querying VirusTotal.
measurement_method: HTTP mock verifying HEAD/GET redirect resolution

requirement: A user shall be able to copy the final verdict text to their operating system clipboard.
measurement_method: Browser clipboard API mock invocation check

requirement: The backend server shall exclude the external API key from all network traffic sent to the client browser.
measurement_method: Response payload inspection asserting VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY absence

requirement: The backend server shall write the scanned domain name and the resulting risk score to a local text file.
measurement_method: Deferred pending change control audit against NFR-SEC-02

requirement: The system shall display the exact time and date of the completed scan alongside the final verdict.
measurement_method: DOM inspection verifying ISO/formatted timestamp presence

requirement: The system shall forcibly prepend http:// to submissions that lack a protocol prefix but otherwise contain a valid domain.
measurement_method: URL parser assertion prepending http:// to bare domain

requirement: The URL scan result page gives an end-to-end response time p95 under 10.0 s with a valid domain submitted over a basic Wi-Fi connection.
measurement_method: 20 manual URL submissions timed via browser tools network tab; record p95 in the measurements log.

requirement: The running URL scanner app gets a health check pass rate of at least 29 out of 30 consecutive days during the final four weeks on the free hosting tier.
measurement_method: A scheduled automated ping that logs pass/fail to a text file.

requirement: A first-time Corporate Employee user finishes the task in under 30 seconds.
measurement_method: Two sessions with a stopwatch; time and find any UI stumbles recorded in notes.

requirement: Exactly 0 shown credentials, API keys, or tokens show up in the repo at any time, or during any user request.
measurement_method: A local grep search for secrets across the full history; manual inspection of the browser network tab.

requirement: The system stores 0 bytes of user-specific scanned URL history to the server disk or database after a user successfully scans a URL and closes the browser.
measurement_method: Manual review of the backend routing to make sure no database write operations are around for user sessions.

requirement: 100% of the time, the UI gives a clear disclaimer right next to the submit button stating: "Warning: URLs scanned here are shared publicly. Do not submit internal company links."
measurement_method: Manual visual inspection of the deployed URL input form on page load.

requirement: 100% of interactive controls are reachable by keyboard alone in a logical order with a focus indicator that can be seen, using only Tab, Shift+Tab, Space, and Enter during the core URL submission and result-copying flow.
measurement_method: Unplug the mouse; run the scan-and-copy flow; write down every situation the focus ring goes away or a control is skipped.

requirement: Screen reader result announcement happens 100% of the time when the final scan result (Safe, Unsafe, Ambiguous, Error) appears on the screen after the API completes and UI moves from loading.
measurement_method: Run a test URL with a screen reader active.

requirement: 100% of form input have an associated descriptive text label on the primary URL submission form.
measurement_method: Manual DOM inspection in browser developer tools.

requirement: All body text and important UI text have a ratio of >= 4.5:1 against the background on all UI states and result displays.
measurement_method: Run a WCAG contrast checker tool on the hex codes that I used for the green/red text against the background color of the app.

requirement: 0 occurrences of information, severity, or state changes are shown by color alone when displaying the final scan answer.
measurement_method: Set device running the test's display to grayscale and go through the main URL flow; making sure that the text specifically shows the result without just using the green or red hues.

requirement: A clean clone from the repository gets to a running local instance in less than 10 minutes using only the instructions in the README.
measurement_method: Clean-machine test: timed manual setup in a fresh directory once per iteration.
